name: @code-moniker/client
description: Typed JavaScript and TypeScript client for the Code Moniker workspace daemon.

scripts.generate: npm run generate:types && npm run generate:protocol
scripts.build: npm run generate && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/build.mjs
scripts.test:unit: npm run build && npm run test:unit:built
scripts.test:consumer: npm run build && npm run test:consumer:built
scripts.test:package:built: node --test test/package.test.mjs && node scripts/verify-native-packages.mjs && node scripts/verify-pack.mjs
scripts.test:package: npm run build && npm run test:package:built
scripts.test:daemon:owned: npm run build && npm run test:daemon:owned:built --
scripts.test:daemon:packaged: npm run build && npm run test:daemon:packaged:built --
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:unit:built && npm run test:consumer:built && npm run test:package:built
